_comment: J13/G-17: performance budgets declared as data, not measured ad hoc. Each k6 scenario in load-tests/scenarios/ imports the relevant entry below and turns it into a real k6 `thresholds` block - the mechanism k6 itself uses to fail a run's exit code when a budget is exceeded. A regression beyond budget fails the run (and, once load-test.yml is triggered on a real deployment, the build).
